description_en: Creates a topic for ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ. A topic is the top-level container for message transmission and storage in ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ, used to identify messages of the same business logic. In the messaging model, producers send messages to a topic, and consumers consume messages by subscribing to a specified topic
description_zh: 创建云消息队列 RocketMQ 版的主题（Topic）。主题是云消息队列 RocketMQ 版中消息传输和存储的顶层容器，用于标识同一类业务逻辑的消息。在消息收发模型中，生产者将消息发送至主题，消费者通过订阅指定的主题来消费其中的消息
kebab_example: aliyun rocketmq create-topic --instance-id rmq-cn-7e22ody0000 --topic-name topic_test --message-type NORMAL --remark This_is_the_remark_for_test. --max-send-tps 1500 --lite-topic-expiration 60 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTopic

parameters.description_en:
The name of the topic to be created. The name is used to identify the topic and must be globally unique.

Naming conventions:

- Character limit: letters a-z or A-Z, digits 0-9, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
- Length limit: 1 to 60 characters.

For reserved character restrictions, see [Parameter limits](~~440347~~).
parameters.description_zh:
待创建主题的名称，用于标识主题，全局唯一。

取值规范如下：

- 字符限制：支持字母a\~z或A\~Z、数字0~9以及下划线（_）、短划线（-）。
- 长度限制：1~60个字符。

保留字符限制，请参见[参数限制](~~440347~~)。

parameters.description_en:
The message type of the topic to be created.

><notice>The type of the topic must be consistent with the type of messages sent to it. For example, if you create a topic of the ordered message type, the topic can be used only to send and receive ordered messages, not other types of messages.></notice>
parameters.description_zh:

Default value: -1, which indicates the topic never expires.
